initialize.instructions: Grades an MCP server's tools/list answer against the MCP specification 2026-07-28, the Anthropic and OpenAI directory rules, hidden-instruction patterns, schema quality and write-surface design. Everything runs locally on the JSON you pass; nothing is sent anywhere.

items.name: check_tools_list
items.title: Check an MCP tool list
items.description: Grades an MCP server's tools/list answer and returns a report: a letter grade per section (MCP specification, Anthropic directory, OpenAI directory, hidden-instruction scan, schema quality) and the write-surface guard coverage (advice, no grade), each finding with its check id and docs link, and the list with safe fixes applied. Use this before submitting a server to the Claude or ChatGPT directories, or in review of a tool list change. Do not use it to compare two versions of a list; use compare_tools_lists for that. It reads only the JSON passed in; it does not connect to the server.

tools_list.description: The tool list to grade: the answer to tools/list, as JSON text or as a value. Accepts a JSON-RPC answer, {"tools": [...]}, a bare array of tools, or an array of pages. Limit 2 MiB of JSON, 64 levels of nesting and 2000 tools.

sections.description: Sections to report and to test against min_grade (surface has no grade and is never below it). Default: all six.

min_grade.description: Lowest acceptable grade. When set, passed is false if any reported section grades below it.

limit.description: Most findings to return, blocking first. Grades and counts always cover every finding.

include_fixed_list.description: Include the whole list with safe fixes applied. Set false for large lists to keep the answer short; the change list is always included.

spec_version.description: MCP specification revision the spec section checks against.

sources_read.description: Date the Anthropic and OpenAI directory rules were last read.

state.description: surface only: what the guard coverage says (it has no grade).

coverage.description: surface only: guards offered out of the opportunities, in total and per guard (retry keys, preconditions, delete guards).

passed.description: False when a reported section is below min_grade.

id.description: Check id; pass it to explain_check.

tools_list.description: The list with the safe fixes applied, in the shape it was given; null when include_fixed_list is false.

items.name: explain_check
items.title: Explain a check
items.description: Returns the documentation for one check by its id: severity, the source rule quoted verbatim, what the finding means and how to fix it, with an example where one exists. Use this when a check_tools_list finding needs more detail. Do not use it to grade a list.

check_id.description: Check id from a check_tools_list finding, for example "anthropic-title".

source_quote.description: The rule, quoted verbatim from its source.

items.name: compare_tools_lists
items.title: Compare two MCP tool lists
items.description: Compares two tools/list answers from the same server by SHA-256 definition hashes and reports tools added, removed and changed, field by field. Flags as high risk any annotation change that lets a client run a tool with less confirmation, the pattern of a rug-pull. Use this when a server updates, before trusting the new list. Do not use it to grade a single list.

before.description: The earlier tool list: the answer to tools/list, as JSON text or as a value. Accepts a JSON-RPC answer, {"tools": [...]}, a bare array of tools, or an array of pages. Limit 2 MiB of JSON, 64 levels of nesting and 2000 tools.

after.description: The newer tool list: the answer to tools/list, as JSON text or as a value. Accepts a JSON-RPC answer, {"tools": [...]}, a bare array of tools, or an array of pages. Limit 2 MiB of JSON, 64 levels of nesting and 2000 tools.

high_risk.description: Tools whose annotation change lets a client run them with less confirmation.
